entities.name: Audrey
entities.description: One of the two speakers; a city dweller whose life centres on her small dogs - Pepper, Precious and Panda, joined by the puppy Pixie at the start of April 2023. She walks them in the park near her several times a day, moved in June 2023 to a house with a bigger backyard, and over 2023 took a positive-reinforcement dog training course, agility classes, a dog grooming course and joined a dog owners group. She cooks, gardens, makes jewellery from recycled objects and has two tattoos of her dogs; a knee injury once stopped her walking them and an accident in October 2023 put one arm in a cast.

entities.name: Andrew
entities.description: The other speaker; a Financial Analyst who started a new job in the week before 27 March 2023 and lives in the city with his girlfriend. He hikes whenever work allows, took up rock climbing in June 2023 and cooking in July, and has been awed by birds since the first session. He spent months searching for a dog-friendly rental and for a dog, and ended 2023 with three - Toby in July, Buddy in October and Scout in November. Work grew steadily more stressful over the year and his time outdoors shrank with it.

entities.name: Andrew's girlfriend
entities.description: Andrew's partner, never named and referred to only as 'my girl', 'my girlfriend' and 'the gf'. She appears in most of his accounts of life outside work: the city cafe scene in April 2023, a hike at his new spot in May, a picnic in July, volunteering at a pet shelter, a camping weekend in August, a farm trip, fishing, board games, a wine tasting, a bike ride, and the naming of Scout in November 2023.

properties.aliases: my girl, my girlfriend, the gf, my GF

entities.name: Andrew's friends
entities.description: The group of friends Andrew hikes and climbs with, never named individually. They were with him on the hike at his new spot over the weekend of 6-7 May 2023, at the rock climbing class on 11 June 2023 where their cheering got him to the top, and on the hike of 23 June 2023.

entities.name: Audrey's dogs
entities.description: The group Audrey calls her pups, fur babies and fur kids: three dogs - Pepper, Precious and Panda - which she had had for about three years by March 2023, and the puppy Pixie who joined them at the start of April 2023, making four. All mutts. They walk with her several times a day, do agility twice a week from August 2023, play fetch and frisbee, sleep curled up together, and are the subject of most of what she says.

properties.aliases: my pups, fur babies, fur kids, my four doggies, the pooches

entities.name: Pepper
entities.description: One of Audrey's dogs, named on 27 March 2023 among the original three. She took a while to get used to the puppy Pixie in April 2023 and was inseparable from her afterwards; she likes to lounge on the couch. Audrey described her as one of two Jack Russell mixes in July 2023 and as a Lab mix in October 2023.

entities.name: Precious
entities.description: One of Audrey's dogs, named on 27 March 2023 among the original three; she has her own chair to relax in. Andrew named her as the dog whose leash broke at the park on 22 September 2023. Audrey described her as a Chihuahua mix in October 2023.

entities.name: Panda
entities.description: One of Audrey's dogs, named on 27 March 2023 among the original three; male, and he relaxes on his rug. Audrey described him as a Lab mix in October 2023.

entities.name: Pixie
entities.description: The puppy Audrey adopted shortly before 2 April 2023, making her household four dogs. She took a few days to settle with the others and then became inseparable from Pepper; she curls up in her own bed. Audrey described her as a Chihuahua mix in October 2023.

entities.name: the city
entities.description: The unnamed city where both Audrey and Andrew live; neither of them ever names it. It is the constant background of the conversation - Audrey keeps her dogs as city dogs and found her dog-friendly home through rental websites, while Andrew spent 2023 unable to find a dog-friendly rental and said repeatedly that city living kept him from nature.

entities.name: Fox Hollow
entities.description: A hiking trail Andrew recommended to Audrey on 27 March 2023, saying he hikes it at weekends for the views. Audrey said she would try it, but had still not been by 2 April 2023 because the new puppy was keeping her busy.

entities.name: the park near Audrey’s home
entities.description: The unnamed park near Audrey's home, referred to as 'the park near me', 'the park we usually walk' and 'our local park'. She walks her dogs there several times a day, plays fetch and meets other owners; it is where a dog's leash broke on 22 September 2023 and where she had the accident that put her arm in a cast in October 2023. A dog park stands right beside it.

entities.name: the dog park near Audrey’s home
entities.description: A dog park right beside the park Audrey usually walks in, with a big grassy area for the dogs and trees and benches for the owners. She uses it for doggie playdates and, from August 2023, for her dogs' agility practice twice a week.

entities.name: Andrew's new hiking spot
entities.description: The open space near the city that Andrew found shortly before 3 May 2023, after a spell of feeling shut in. He said he tried to escape to it at least once a weekend, and hiked there with friends and his girlfriend over the weekend of 6-7 May 2023.

entities.name: Andrew's employer
entities.description: The unnamed firm where Andrew started as a Financial Analyst in the week before 27 March 2023, a big change from his previous job. Work there grew steadily heavier: piling up and stressful by July 2023, tough enough by September that his outdoor activities took a back seat, and by October 2023 the reason he gave for losing his work-life balance.

entities.name: Audrey's dog training course
entities.description: The positive reinforcement dog training Audrey found on a flyer at her local pet store: a workshop on bonding with her pets that she signed up for in May 2023 for the following month, and the demanding but rewarding course she was taking by 3 July 2023. Recorded as one thing because the dates and the subject line up. She called it a big time sink and said her dogs were already doing better on it.

entities.name: hiking
entities.description: The activity both speakers care most about and the one they kept planning to do together. Audrey hikes with her dogs - a national park road trip in May 2023, a peak at sunset in late May, a two-hour trail in August - while Andrew hikes whenever work and the city allow, at Fox Hollow, at the open space he found in May 2023, and with friends and his girlfriend.

entities.name: birdwatching
entities.description: Andrew has been awed by birds, and eagles in particular, since the first session. In March 2023 he said he had never gone out birdwatching deliberately but spotted birds while hiking; by October 2023 he said he enjoyed it, had binoculars and a notebook and read books about ecosystems. Audrey said in October 2023 that she wanted to take it up and was working through a guide book.

entities.name: Andrew's search for a dog
entities.description: The search Andrew ran from April 2023 for a dog of his own - browsing websites, visiting shelters and asking friends, while weighing what size of dog suits an apartment. It was still going in June 2023 and ended when he took home the puppy Toby shortly before 11 July 2023.

entities.name: Andrew's search for a dog-friendly home
entities.description: Andrew’s long search for somewhere in the city to rent that allows dogs, ideally near a park or woods so a dog would have space to run. Running from April 2023 through contacting landlords and checking neighbourhoods, it was still unresolved on 6 September 2023; by 4 November 2023 he said he had managed to make keeping two dogs work in the city as it was.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Audrey's childhood dog, full of energy and fond of fetch. As a child she took long walks with him around the neighbourhood, exploring new paths and confiding her worries and hopes in him; she counts those among her favourite memories.

entities.name: Toby
entities.description: Andrew's first dog, a German Shepherd puppy he took home shortly before 11 July 2023 after months of searching. Active and fond of sweaters, still too young to hike in September 2023. He chased a squirrel round a tree at the dog park, went camping and played board games with Andrew and his girlfriend, and was joined by Buddy in October and Scout in November 2023.

entities.name: Audrey's new house
entities.description: The house with a bigger backyard that Audrey moved into shortly before 26 June 2023. She set up a doggy play area there with agility equipment and toys, was still unpacking boxes at the end of June, and keeps a small garden with flowers and a vegetable patch.

entities.name: Audrey's dog agility classes
entities.description: Agility classes Audrey started with her dogs at a dog park at the beginning of August 2023. She takes them to practise twice a week and called it a good physical and mental workout and a bonding experience, tough at times but going well.

entities.name: the pet shelter Andrew volunteered at
entities.description: The unnamed pet shelter where Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered on Monday 24 July 2023. He called it one of the most rewarding things he had ever done and their way of giving back; Audrey said in the same exchange that she had never been to an animal shelter.

entities.name: rock climbing
entities.description: Andrew took a rock climbing class with friends on Sunday 11 June 2023, reached the top and said he was hooked. He was still a newbie and found the climb tricky; it encouraged him to plan more outdoor activities, naming kayaking and possibly bungee jumping.

entities.name: cooking
entities.description: Audrey loves cooking and treats it as an escape and a form of self-care, often with music on and a glass of wine; her favourite recipe is her family’s Chicken Pot Pie and her go-to ingredient is garlic. Andrew took it up in the summer of 2023 as something he could do while unable to hike, and said it helped him de-stress and be creative.

entities.name: the hike Audrey and Andrew planned together
entities.description: The hike with all their dogs that Audrey and Andrew agreed on 8 July 2023 to take the following month, and kept putting off: still 'next month' on 1 October and 19 October 2023, and finally set on 28 October 2023 for Saturday 4 November at a dog-friendly trail by a lake, with snacks. No session says it took place.

entities.name: Audrey's dog grooming course
entities.description: The course on which Audrey learned to groom her dogs herself during August 2023. She passed its techniques on to Andrew: groom slowly and gently, mind sensitive areas such as ears and paws, and stay patient and positive.

entities.name: gardening
entities.description: Audrey keeps a small garden at her new house with flowers - Peruvian Lilies, which she says are easy to care for - and a vegetable patch. She said it relaxes her and feels like an accomplishment to watch things grow, and her dogs run around in it.

entities.name: Buddy
entities.description: Andrew's second dog, adopted from a shelter shortly before 19 October 2023 and named Buddy because he is Andrew's buddy and Andrew hoped he and Toby would become buddies. He enjoys walks and new hiking trails, and needed time to settle with Toby.

entities.name: Scout
entities.description: Andrew's third dog, adopted shortly before 22 November 2023 and named by Andrew and his girlfriend for the dog's adventurous spirit. His first outing was to be a small park nearby, kept on a leash, and he was given a bed, toys and puppy pads at home.

entities.name: Audrey's dog owners group
entities.description: A group of dog owners Audrey joined shortly before 4 November 2023 to learn to care for her dogs better. She meets them about once a week for tips from other owners and so the dogs can play together; seeing a photograph of them made Andrew think about a third dog.

entities.name: the animal shelter Audrey donates to
entities.description: The unnamed animal shelter to which Audrey donates a portion of the profits from her recycled jewellery. She said on 6 October 2023 that it does great work and that donating is her way of helping out; Andrew said in the same exchange that she could no longer volunteer there.

entities.name: making jewellery from recycled objects
entities.description: Audrey makes one-of-a-kind jewellery out of bottle caps, buttons and broken jewellery, which she describes as combining creativity with sustainability and a small step in reducing waste. It began as a hobby and she later started selling it, donating a portion of the profits to an animal shelter.

entities.name: Audrey's knee injury
entities.description: A knee injury that at some point before October 2023 stopped Audrey walking her dogs. She said it was hard because they bring her so much joy, and shared a photograph taken after she was able to start walking them again.

entities.name: Audrey's broken arm
entities.description: The injury Audrey suffered in an accident while playing with her dogs at the park in the week before 24 October 2023, leaving one arm in a cast. She said caring for four dogs one-handed was tricky but that they were managing and she felt better each day.
